_readme: Every file under public/assets/ MUST have one entry here. Run `npm run assets:check` to verify. Human-readable version: CREDITS.md. Allowed licences: CC0, CC-BY, OGA-BY, OFL, MIT (record attribution if the licence needs it). Do not add assets with NC (non-commercial) or ND (no-derivatives) terms.
